7.4.11.4 Data Bytes in First Frames
Not compliant to ISO 15765-2
[SWS_FrArTp_00120] ⌈If acknowledgement with Retry is configured for the corre-
sponding channel, no payload is sent within an FF-x if a segmented transfer takes
place.⌋
This is necessary to retain backwards compatibility to the AUTOSAR release 3 FrTp
on bus level.
[SWS_FrArTp_00121] ⌈If acknowledgment without Retry (or no acknowledgement) is
configured, there are data bytes within an FF-x.⌋
caption: 7.4.11.4 Data Bytes in First Frames
